info.title: AI Service Gateway
info.description:
Unified AI service gateway with multi-protocol adapters, rate limiting, circuit breaking, and session management.

**Core features:**
- JWT authentication with RBAC and multi-tenant isolation
- LangGraph Platform proxy with load balancing and streaming SSE
- Knowledge base management with hybrid RAG retrieval
- AI quiz/exam system with scoring and analytics
- Real-time usage metrics and billing

**Auth:** All endpoints (except `/health` and `/api/v1/auth/login`) require `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

get.description: Native Gateway metadata-only reader. Requires exact admin role or case-insensitive admin tier. Cross-tenant access; tenant_id filters the recorded actor tenant, not resource ownership. Coverage and retention are not guaranteed. Offset pages can shift during concurrent writes.

post.description:
Grade an anonymous viewer's answers against the frozen quiz snapshot.

* No auth required. Rate-limited by IP via ``enforce_rate_limit``.
* Keyed by ``(share_code, anon_id, quiz_id)`` using the trusted anonymous
  middleware identity — one attempt per viewer per quiz; resubmits return
  the cached result rather than re-grading.
* Grades against the **frozen** answer key embedded in the share's
  snapshot, so even if the original quiz row is deleted the share still
  functions.

ModelUpdate.title: ModelUpdate
ModelUpdate.description:
Request to update a model.

``model_id`` is renameable — the frontend now exposes it in the edit
dialog so a provider's model rename (e.g. ``gemini-3-flash-preview`` →
``gemini-3.1-flash``) doesn't require delete+recreate. Server-side
rename pushes an UPDATE on the primary key; the pricing-table sync
also follows the new id.

title.description: Must contain non-whitespace text. Stored after trimming.

message.description: Must contain non-whitespace text; stored unchanged.

model_id.description: Explicit model ID; nonblank, at most 255 UTF-8 bytes. Launch rechecks access and availability.

run_at.description: RFC3339 instant strictly in the future when validated.

interval_seconds.description: Omitted or null means one-time; otherwise fixed delay from terminal settlement.

notification_read_at.description: Additive epoch013 owner acknowledgement. NULL means unread; not proof of delivery or success.

detail.description: Schedule/admission/storage errors use an object with code. Rate-limit failures use a string.

catalog_revision_token.description: Exact unsigned catalog revision for mutation preconditions; avoids JavaScript precision loss.

expected_revision.description: Last observed tenant plugin revision as exact decimal text; 0 creates a binding.

expected_tenant_id.description: Observed tenant identity precondition, compared to the authenticated tenant. Never an authority or a target override.
